# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts tightly (low volatility) then expands with price closing above the longest EMA, it indicates an imminent volatility‑driven trend start. This edge exists because sustained compression often precedes expansion, and a break above the ribbon with increased volume confirms institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Calculate the distance between the 8‑ and 50‑period EMAs. If this distance contracts for at least 4 consecutive bars to < 0.05x the 20‑period ATR and then on the next bar price closes above the 50‑period EMA with volume > 1.3x average volume, enter long at the close. Exit: Stop at the lowest low of the compression phase (the lowest low during the 4‑bar contraction); target at 1.5R or trail using a 20‑period chandelier exit after 1R profit.
